config.label: AnyAPI API key (format: aa_live_
config.description: AnyAPI API key (format: aa_live_...). Mint one at https://getanyapi.com/dashboard/keys. Needed to run an API; connecting, listing the tools, and the catalog tools (list_apis, search_apis, get_api, quote_api) all work without it.

config.label: AnyAPI API key as a Bearer token (format: Bearer aa_live_
config.description: AnyAPI API key as a Bearer token (format: Bearer aa_live_...). Mint one at https://getanyapi.com/dashboard/keys. Needed to run an API; connecting, listing the tools, and the catalog tools (list_apis, search_apis, get_api, quote_api) all work without it.
